data.exact_reserve_text: A favorable run-off deviation (prior accident year decrease) of GBP 0.9m (2015: adverse run-off deviation of GBP 1.9m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable run-off deviation of GBP 0.9m relating to reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003 (release).

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a small favourable prior-year run-off of GBP 0.9m in 2016 (a release), linked wholly to reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share with Syndicate 2003. The release is described as portfolio-wide under the quota share arrangement rather than tied to a single named catastrophe; no quantified LOB-level movements were disclosed.
